note: Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into static_data and handed to the config parser entry point.
The fuzzer wrapper trims one byte and initializes the lexer over the supplied buffer.
The lexer is set to scan the attacker buffer from the beginning to the adjusted end.
A leading triple-quote sequence diverts lexing into multiline-string mode.
The lexer chooses the closing delimiter for the multiline string it is about to scan.

code: if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) { emit(lexer, LEXEME_STRING); lexer->pos += 3; return lex_config; }
note: The loop reads through the input until it finds the terminator; on a short malformed input it can advance past the mapped end and perform an out-of-bounds read.
